state:
**Goal `html-later`: Stages 3 and 4 are closed, and Stage 5 (the proofs gate) is open.** ADR 0266 decides the goal. `crates/nvs-runtime/src/later.rs` holds the slots and both deliveries, and its module doc § *A slotted response* says how the slotted one works and what it costs.

**On disk:** `Core\Html::later` owes nothing. It has `about.md`, three examples with `.out`, one attack (`tests/hostile/core/Html/later/01-fake-and-repeated-placeholders.nvs`), one bench with a recorded figure, and `// covers: Core\Html::later` on `fills_arrive_in_the_order_their_later_finished` in `crates/nvs-server/src/slotted/tests.rs`. Every one of them runs its page through `Core\Test::request`, because `nvs run --request` is not an HTML response (playbook, *Writing a test case*). `// covers: Core\Response::slotted` is already on `slotted_from_a_route_attribute_and_from_the_call_are_the_same` in the same file.

**`bun nv proofs --gate` now owes one feature**, `Core\Response::slotted`. It owes `about.md`, 3 examples, 1 attack and 1 bench.

**The polyfill browser test** (`tools/nv/test/html-later-polyfill.test.ts`) was red in the driver's full run and green alone. The cause was not reproduced. Its tab wait is now bounded by the test's timeout and not by a 5 s loop, and Chromium's stderr is drained after launch, so a loaded machine is slower but no longer fails. If the full run still marks it red, read that run's output for the failing test.

**Known gaps, in `later.rs`'s module doc:** slots run when the frame returns, concurrently with each other but not with the main script. A `later` inside a `Core\Task::all` child is never assembled. A slot whose task is cancelled while it writes ends the stream, and the fills after it are not sent.

items.text: **`Core\Response::slotted`'s proofs**: `about.md`, three examples with `.out` (`bun nv proofs --bless`), one attack and one bench, for the row at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/response.rs:406` (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). Copy the request shape of `docs/examples/core/Html/later/01-two-parts-of-a-page.nvs`. First check what `Core\Test::request` returns for a slotted page: the assembled body, or the shell and its fills. Every comment follows `AGENTS.md` § *Text an end user reads*, so run `bun nv proofs --comments` over the new files.

**The gate is green**: `bun nv proofs --gate` owes nothing. Record the bench with `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only 'Core\Response::slotted'`. `--group` takes a group id, not a path. Re-record `later` the same way if `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/html.rs:403` changes (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
